title: Complete Guide to Go Concurrency
title_es: Guía Completa de Concurrencia en Go
description: Go concurrency patterns: worker pool, pipeline with context cancellation, semaphore via buffered channel, errgroup fan-out, and a goroutine leak fix.
description_es: Patrones de concurrencia en Go: worker pool, pipeline con cancelación de context, semáforo vía buffered channel, fan-out con errgroup y fix de goroutine leak.
